title: ATTP OPEN Autumn 2024 – an exceptional finale to the sporting year!
excerpt: ATTP OPEN Autumn 2024 – an exceptional finale to the sporting year!
body_html:
ATTP OPEN is one of the most important men’s table tennis events in the Republic of Moldova and part of the SUPER CUP series of tournaments held every season of the year.

The event brought together top players and talented amateurs from across the country for a fantastic day of intense competition at the TOP CUP Academy arena in Chișinău.

With its popularity growing steadily, ATTP OPEN keeps promoting table tennis in the Republic of Moldova and effectively strengthening the community of honest table tennis players.
